mapper.select: SELECT f.* FROM studyroom_fragments f JOIN studyroom_runs r ON r.id=f.run_id JOIN study_rooms s ON s.current_run_id=r.id JOIN study_outline_drafts d ON d.id=r.draft_id WHERE f.run_id=#{runId} AND f.unit_id=#{unitId} AND r.user_id=#{userId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND d.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY f.fragment_order DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT unit_spec_json FROM studyroom_units WHERE id=#{unitId}
SELECT * FROM studyroom_check_sets WHERE fragment_id=#{fragmentId} AND content_revision=#{revision}
mapper.update: UPDATE studyroom_check_sets SET status='FAILED',failure_code='CHECK_INVALID' WHERE fragment_id=#{fragmentId} AND content_revision=#{revision}
UPDATE studyroom_check_sets SET status='READY',generation_id=#{generationId},failure_code=NULL,pending_job_id=NULL WHERE fragment_id=#{fragmentId} AND content_revision=#{revision}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM studyroom_checks WHERE fragment_id=#{fragmentId} AND content_revision=#{revision} AND generation_id=#{generationId} ORDER BY question_order
SELECT * FROM studyroom_check_attempts WHERE check_id=#{checkId} AND user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY created_at,id
SELECT * FROM studyroom_checks WHERE id=#{checkId} AND run_id=#{runId} AND user_id=#{userId}
SELECT generation_id FROM studyroom_check_sets WHERE fragment_id=#{fragmentId} AND content_revision=#{revision}
SELECT payload_json FROM studyroom_generation_jobs WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND job_type='CHECK' AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING')
mapper.update: UPDATE studyroom_generation_jobs SET priority=#{priority} WHERE id=#{jobId}
UPDATE studyroom_check_sets SET status='PENDING',failure_code=NULL WHERE fragment_id=#{fragmentId} AND content_revision=#{revision}
UPDATE studyroom_check_sets SET pending_job_id=#{jobId} WHERE fragment_id=#{fragmentId} AND content_revision=#{revision}
mapper.select: SELECT content_json FROM studyroom_fragments WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND unit_id=#{unitId} AND step_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY fragment_order
mapper.update: UPDATE studyroom_check_sets SET status='FAILED',failure_code='CHECK_PREPARATION_FAILED',pending_job_id=NULL WHERE status='PENDING' AND pending_job_id IN (SELECT id FROM studyroom_generation_jobs WHERE status IN ('FAILED','CANCELLED'))
